if(NOT DEFINED FASTGLTF_URL)
    set(FASTGLTF_URL https://github.com/spnda/fastgltf.git)
endif()

get_directory_property(HORIZON_INHERITED_DEFINITIONS COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
list(FILTER HORIZON_INHERITED_DEFINITIONS EXCLUDE REGEX "^(INLINE|FORCEINLINE|NOINLINE|NULLPTR|RESTRICT|NODISCARD)=")
set_directory_properties(PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${HORIZON_INHERITED_DEFINITIONS}")

set(FASTGLTF_COMPILE_AS_CPP20 ON)
set(FASTGLTF_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_ENABLE_TESTS OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_ENABLE_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_ENABLE_DOCS OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_ENABLE_CPP_MODULES OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_USE_CUSTOM_SMALLVECTOR OFF)
set(FASTGLTF_USE_64BIT_FLOAT OFF)

FetchContent_Declare(
    fastgltf
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    GIT_REPOSITORY ${FASTGLTF_URL}
    GIT_TAG v0.9.1
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(fastgltf)
